caption: The drawing features a central horizontal object resembling a stylized arrow with a pointed tip on the right side and a flat, hooked end on the left. This object is rendered in a gray, wood-like texture and is decorated with a series of circular holes running along its length, arranged both centrally and near the edges in a symmetrical pattern. Above and below the midpoint of the arrow, there are two spherical objects, also with a gray, wood-like appearance, connected to the main arrow by a thin vertical line or rod. The background of the image is plain and off-white, with no additional elements or colors besides the gray and brown hues in the main objects. The composition is centered, with the arrow running horizontally and the two spheres aligned vertically along the center.
title: Weather Vane
